# An NPS survey that tells you why the score is what it is.

> Run surveys and Net Promoter Score on a server you own: NPS with a 95% range, the words detractors use, results by source, CSV export and an alert on every detractor. Open source, MIT, no per-response fee. Try the NPS calculator in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
